question: Does the Phase-12 oracle experiment continue to provide credible descriptive evidence that regional high-resolution processing has mechanistic value?
prospective_evidence: positive aggregate Dice across all four models; mean delta Dice +0.0698 .. +0.1901; large object-recall recovery; component recovery; TINY/SMALL recovery; empty recovery; difficult-cohort response
allowed_interpretation: carry the Phase-12 conclusion forward unless an integrity/reproduction defect is demonstrated
forbidden_posthoc_behavior: re-labelling A as unsupported merely because the GT-free localizer performs poorly

question: Does the frozen GT-free predicted-region pipeline retain meaningful downstream segmentation utility relative to the global baseline and the Phase-12 oracle upper-bound/mechanism result?
prospective_evidence: per_model: D_GLOBAL; D_ORACLE; D_PREDICTED; DELTA_ORACLE_DICE; DELTA_PRED_DICE; RETENTION_DICE; ORACLE_GAP_DICE; IoU gain retention; object-recall gain retention; FN-reduction retention; component recovery events; component lost events; empty recovery events; new-empty events; localization-coverage -> segmentation-recovery linkage
allowed_interpretation: meaningful practical downstream utility means segmentation utility, NOT merely proposal/localization coverage
forbidden_posthoc_behavior: declaring B satisfied from proposal coverage alone; inventing a retention cutoff after seeing results

question: Does predicted regional replacement preserve acceptable global segmentation behavior, or does it introduce broad adverse segmentation cost?
prospective_evidence: per_model: mean Dice delta PREDICTED-GLOBAL; mean IoU delta; mean precision delta; mean recall delta; mean FP pixel delta; mean FN pixel delta; cases improved; cases unchanged; cases worsened; maximum case improvement; maximum case worsening; new empty predictions; empty recoveries; component recoveries; component losses
allowed_interpretation: descriptive comparison of benefit versus adverse cost; heterogeneity reported explicitly
forbidden_posthoc_behavior: declaring C acceptable by ignoring FP/precision cost; inventing an FP-increase allowance after seeing results

question: Is the practical signal supported across the four frozen architectures rather than being an architecture-specific accident?
forbidden_posthoc_behavior: selecting a favourable architecture post hoc; declaring a winner; averaging heterogeneity away

prospective_meaning: Oracle helps AND predicted localization retains meaningful practical utility.
required_evidence_pattern: A remains supported; B shows meaningful practical GT-free downstream utility rather than merely proposal coverage; C does not show broad systematic degradation that undermines the practical benefit; D shows the signal is not merely an isolated architecture-specific artifact
action: Promote the regional mechanism toward RA-MedFiLM-Seg++.

prospective_meaning: Oracle helps BUT predicted localization loses too much practical benefit / global preservation cost is materially problematic; the regional hypothesis is not abandoned, but the deployable localization/fusion path requires revision.
required_evidence_pattern: A remains supported; at least one of: B is weak, inconsistent, or fails to translate the oracle mechanism into sufficient deployable segmentation utility; C shows material preservation / FP-cost problems; D indicates the effect is too architecture-specific
action: Do not abandon the hypothesis; redesign localizer work first. Do NOT automatically redesign the localizer in Part 1E.

prospective_meaning: Even oracle evidence is insufficient / invalidated; do not force regional complexity.
required_evidence_pattern: A is no longer scientifically supportable; e.g. the Phase-12 oracle mechanism evidence is invalidated by a material integrity/reproduction problem, or no longer demonstrates meaningful regional mechanism value
action: Do not force regional complexity; proceed with global multi-domain MedFiLM and document the negative evidence.

prospective_meaning: An integrity precondition failed; scientific integrity takes precedence over gate classification.
required_evidence_pattern: at least one material unresolved integrity failure in Part1D-B
